execution_policy: Quote primary scalar and internal effect count once in the original active CAST body from the actual caster permanent programs. Additional effects do not create casts/payments. Each damage execution requeries live enemy minions and partitions its single immune Spell Damage budget; each summon uses the unchanged full host minion pool and actual native cause. Each draw discounts only its original actual hand arrival. Map delivers three cards in the displayed primary child order then chooses an upgrade. Initial/order/quote/unit/routing nuances remain explicit local policy pending CN. Each extra summon effect accepts its own one-count pool request only after the previous effect/reactions. Full-board selection-before-space follows the existing pool batch contract; its RNG footprint is not elided.
